title: Subthalamic local field potentials during the balloon analogue risk task (Pearson et al., 2017): Parkinson's disease DBS surgery (derivative: decimated LFP)
description: Intraoperative subthalamic nucleus (STN) local field potential recordings from patients with Parkinson's disease undergoing deep brain stimulation implantation while performing a self-paced balloon analogue risk task. This derivative release repackages the decimated 200 Hz LFP from 17 recordings in 14 patients into BIDS iEEG format, with behavioural and artifact-censoring tables as events. It supports analysis of neural activity preceding impulsive and risky choices.
methods_description: Recordings were made at Duke University Medical Center with a Plexon MAP system and FHC Guideline 4000, using single tungsten microelectrodes or a 32-channel Pt/Ir microwire array. LFP was acquired at 1 kHz and decimated to 200 Hz. Spikes were sorted offline with WaveClus. Participants performed the balloon analogue risk task during STN localisation.
